views.definition:
SELECT r.id AS repo_id,
    r.name AS repo_name,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)) AS confirmed_hits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'audit_missed'::text)) AS audit_misses,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'audit_false_positive'::text)) AS audit_false_positives,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'severity_understated'::text)) AS severity_understated,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'severity_overstated'::text)) AS severity_overstated,
    round((NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)))::numeric, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed_hit'::text, 'audit_false_positive'::text]))))::numeric, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS user_visible_precision,
    round((NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = 'confirmed_hit'::text)))::numeric, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.correlation_type = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed_hit'::text, 'audit_missed'::text]))))::numeric, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS user_visible_recall
   FROM ((audit_repos r
     LEFT JOIN persona_test_sessions s ON ((s.repo_name = r.name)))
     LEFT JOIN persona_audit_correlations c ON ((c.persona_session_id = s.id)))
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name;

SELECT repo_id,
    severity,
    deferred_reason,
    count(*) AS count,
    min(deferred_at) AS oldest,
    max(deferred_at) AS newest,
    array_agg(DISTINCT category) AS categories
   FROM debt_entries
  GROUP BY repo_id, severity, deferred_reason
  ORDER BY
        CASE severity
            WHEN 'HIGH'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'MEDIUM'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END, (count(*)) DESC;

SELECT id,
    repo_id,
    cluster_hash,
    severity_history,
    first_seen,
    last_seen,
    occurrence_count,
    latest_finding_id,
    files_affected,
    cluster_label,
    status
   FROM recurring_finding_clusters
  WHERE ((occurrence_count >= 3) AND (status = 'open'::text) AND (('HIGH'::text = ANY (severity_history)) OR ((occurrence_count >= 5) AND ('MEDIUM'::text = ANY (severity_history)))))
  ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, last_seen DESC
 LIMIT 50;

SELECT af.id,
    ar.repo_id,
    af.severity,
    af.category AS title,
    af.detail_snapshot AS body,
    af.dismiss_reason,
    af.primary_file,
    af.created_at,
    ar.commit_sha,
    ar.branch
   FROM (audit_findings af
     JOIN audit_runs ar ON ((ar.id = af.run_id)))
  WHERE (af.user_action = 'needs_triage'::text)
  ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN (af.severity = 'HIGH'::text) THEN 0
            WHEN (af.severity = 'MEDIUM'::text) THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END, af.created_at DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
         SELECT i.plan_id,
            i.criterion_hash,
            i.description,
            i.severity,
            i.category,
            i.passed,
            i.created_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i.plan_id, i.criterion_hash ORDER BY i.created_at DESC) AS rn
           FROM plan_verification_items i
        )
 SELECT plan_id,
    criterion_hash,
    description,
    severity,
    category,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT passed)) AS fail_count_last_5,
    max(created_at) FILTER (WHERE (NOT passed)) AS last_failure_at
   FROM ranked
  WHERE (rn <= 5)
  GROUP BY plan_id, criterion_hash, description, severity, category
 HAVING (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT passed)) >= 2)
  ORDER BY severity, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (NOT passed))) DESC;

SELECT id,
    name,
    description,
    app_url,
    app_name,
    repo_name,
    notes,
    last_tested_at,
    last_verdict,
    last_focus,
    test_count,
    created_at
   FROM personas p
  ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN (last_tested_at IS NULL) THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END, last_tested_at;

SELECT r.id AS repo_id,
    r.name AS repo_name,
    (COALESCE(count(pts.id) FILTER (WHERE (pts.created_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval))), (0)::bigint))::integer AS density_30d
   FROM (audit_repos r
     LEFT JOIN persona_test_sessions pts ON ((pts.repo_name = r.name)))
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name;

SELECT p.id AS plan_id,
    p.path AS plan_path,
    p.skill AS plan_skill,
    p.status AS plan_status,
    r.id AS latest_run_id,
    r.created_at AS last_verified_at,
    r.commit_sha AS verified_commit_sha,
    r.url AS verified_url,
    r.total_criteria,
    r.passed_count,
    r.failed_count,
    r.skipped_count,
    round((NULLIF((100.0 * (r.passed_count)::numeric), (0)::numeric) / (NULLIF(r.total_criteria, 0))::numeric), 1) AS satisfaction_pct,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', i.description, 'category', i.category, 'error', i.error_message, 'hash', i.criterion_hash)), '[]'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM plan_verification_items i
          WHERE ((i.run_id = r.id) AND (i.passed = false) AND (i.severity = 'P0'::text))) AS failing_p0_criteria,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', i.description, 'category', i.category, 'error', i.error_message, 'hash', i.criterion_hash)), '[]'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM plan_verification_items i
          WHERE ((i.run_id = r.id) AND (i.passed = false) AND (i.severity = 'P1'::text))) AS failing_p1_criteria
   FROM (plans p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT plan_verification_runs.id,
            plan_verification_runs.plan_id,
            plan_verification_runs.spec_id,
            plan_verification_runs.commit_sha,
            plan_verification_runs.url,
            plan_verification_runs.total_criteria,
            plan_verification_runs.passed_count,
            plan_verification_runs.failed_count,
            plan_verification_runs.skipped_count,
            plan_verification_runs.duration_ms,
            plan_verification_runs.run_context,
            plan_verification_runs.created_at
           FROM plan_verification_runs
          WHERE (plan_verification_runs.plan_id = p.id)
          ORDER BY plan_verification_runs.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON (true));

SELECT rs.id AS spec_id,
    rs.spec_path,
    rs.description,
    rs.source_kind,
    rr.commit_sha,
    rr.error_message,
    rr.created_at AS caught_at
   FROM (regression_specs rs
     JOIN regression_spec_runs rr ON ((rr.spec_id = rs.id)))
  WHERE (rr.captured_regression = true)
  ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC;

SELECT reason.value AS reason_code,
    count(*) AS occurrences,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (se.overridden_by_user = true)) AS overridden,
    round(((100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (se.overridden_by_user = true)))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric), 1) AS override_pct
   FROM ship_events se,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(se.block_reasons) reason(value)
  GROUP BY reason.value
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

SELECT f.id AS audit_finding_id,
    f.run_id AS audit_run_id,
    r.repo_id,
    f.severity,
    f.category,
    f.primary_file,
    f.detail_snapshot,
    r.created_at AS fixed_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM regression_specs rs
          WHERE ((rs.source_finding_type = 'audit'::text) AND (rs.source_finding_id = f.id) AND (rs.source_kind <> 'persona-consistency-candidate'::text))) AS lock_spec_count
   FROM (audit_findings f
     JOIN audit_runs r ON ((r.id = f.run_id)))
  WHERE ((f.severity = 'HIGH'::text) AND (f.adjudication_outcome = 'accepted'::text) AND (f.remediation_state = ANY (ARRAY['fixed'::text, 'verified'::text])) AND (r.created_at > (now() - '14 days'::interval)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM regression_specs rs
          WHERE ((rs.source_finding_type = 'audit'::text) AND (rs.source_finding_id = f.id) AND (rs.source_kind <> 'persona-consistency-candidate'::text))))));
